issues.description: The problem statement and template assume a screen buffer for resolution 1920×1080 (4 bytes per pixel => 1920*1080*4 = 8,294,400 bytes), and the template reserves display_start RESB 8294400 accordingly. The solution repository, however, reserves a much smaller buffer (display_start RESB 409600, i.e. only 320×320×4) and even comments that only 320×320 is reserved. This contradicts the exercise specification (1920×1080) and the template. Students comparing template, problem text and solution will be confused: the solution's buffer is too small for the required resolution and will lead to out-of-bounds accesses for coordinates beyond 320×320, or make it unclear which resolution they must implement.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution's display_start reservation consistent with the problem and template. Change the solution repository to reserve 8,294,400 bytes (e.g. display_start RESB 8294400) and update or remove the misleading comment about 320×320. Alternatively, if the intent was to use a smaller test buffer, update the problem statement and template to clearly state and use that smaller resolution so all artifacts agree.
